talks.title: Rethinking vector databases
talks.speaker: Pablo Haddad
talks.abstract: Why vector databases is harder than it looks, and a design that holds up. Expect concrete numbers, a few failure stories and an open-source companion repo. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 182 people.

talks.title: Rethinking long-context attention
talks.speaker: Rosa Moreau
talks.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached long-context attention over the past year. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Expected audience: about 194 participants.

talks.title: Lessons from SQLite at the edge in production

talks.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with SQLite at the edge and how we fixed them. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. We expect around 30 attendees.
